name: How do general contractors handle insurance claims for storm damage?

mainEntity.name: How do general contractors handle insurance claims for storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Experienced general contractors often work closely with homeowners and insurance companies throughout the storm damage claim process. They can provide detailed estimates and documentation that align with insurance requirements, act as a liaison to explain the scope of work to adjusters, and help ensure that all covered damages are accounted for. While they cannot negotiate your claim, their expertise can significantly streamline communication and help secure appropriate coverage for necessary repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: General contractors provide detailed estimates, documentation, and communicate with adjusters to help streamline the insurance claim process for storm damage repairs.
